user.title: Danfoss Ally Gateway (local)
user.description: Connect to the gateway over your LAN using the Tuya protocol. The device ID and protocol version can be found with `tools/danfoss_probe.py scan`.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter the gateway's local key
reauth_confirm.description: The gateway rejected the local key. This happens if the gateway was reset or re-paired.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the gateway. Check the IP address, and that nothing else (LocalTuya, tinytuya) holds the single local connection.
error.invalid_auth: The gateway rejected the local key or protocol version.
error.no_subdevices: Connected, but the gateway reported no sub-devices.
